description: JLPT N5 and N4 full-depth curriculum — radicals, kanji, vocabulary, grammar, readings, and precomputed dependency graph for bundled app import. N3/N2/N1 carry a kanji-only skeleton (the 553 kanji N5/N4 vocabulary needs, plus the 10 radicals that decompose them): item lists, readings and meanings, no mnemonics, art, examples or vocabulary. Their kanji→vocabulary edges are live: the lesson planner pulls a word's required parents forward whatever level teaches them (docs/content/kanji-coverage-and-dependency-order-plan.md Phase 3).
maintainer_notes: Bump version in this file before every content publish. Run npm run validate-schema && npm run compile-curriculum from repo root, then commit mobile/assets/curriculum-seed/curriculum.db via Git LFS.
